decision_changing_new_fact: Nightscape Familiar reduces Grinning Ignus's generic casting requirement {2}{R} to {1}{R} (once, not twice), while front-face Birgi produces {R} for EVERY Ignus creature cast. Existing three permanents therefore repeatedly generate one NET {C} per full sorcery-speed Ignus cycle while maintaining the same starting {R} float, even without Impact Tremors. Cutting Familiar for Veyran destroys that accumulated colorless-mana loop and loses a one-generic Abaddon commander discount; prior Stage9 Veyran-for-Familiar variants did not fully charge this opportunity cost.

prerequisites: Nightscape Familiar ({1}{B}) on battlefield as a static reducer
Birgi FRONT ({2}{R}) on battlefield as spell-cast red producer
Grinning Ignus ({2}{R}) on battlefield, main phase with empty stack and {R} float
No Rule of Law or opponent response; Ignus activation is as a sorcery but does NOT tap or require haste
one_full_cycle_reducer_present: Activate Ignus for {R}, RETURN it to its owner's hand as cost. Ignus's activated mana ability immediately adds {C}{C}{R} without using the stack; its 'Activate only as a sorcery' restriction still applies.
Cast Ignus for reduced {1}{R}: spend 1 {C}+1 {R}, retain 1 {C}; Birgi cast trigger resolves creating 1 {R}.
Ignus resolves and returns to battlefield. Clear pending ETB/cascade triggers before next sorcery-speed activation. Finish float {R}+{C}, net +{C}.

After N uncontested repetitions, float {R}+N {C}; arbitrary colorless/storm count, NOT arbitrary red. Every later qualifying Abaddon-granted cascade from hand is a separate stack event and only if X already high enough.
one_cycle_without_reducer: Recast for full {2}{R} consuming all {C}{C}{R}, Birgi still produces {R}.
Finish with {R}, 0 net {C}; the creature-cast loop still exists but no infinite colorless-mana growth.
mana_state_proof.impact_payoff: With Impact Tremors on battlefield, Ignus ETB after each cast deals 1 damage to each of three opponents, X+=3 each successful cycle (assuming no prevention or replacement). Familiar makes this loop additionally accumulate colorless; the full three-piece Birgi/Ignus/Tremors outlet does NOT strictly require Familiar.
mana_state_proof.commander_curve: Abaddon {2}{U}{B}{R} costs {1}{U}{B}{R} with Nightscape, enabling a four-mana U/B/R-supported turn if Familiar was already deployed; without Familiar Abaddon costs five mana. Veyran {1}{U}{R} cannot substitute for that discount; it doubles only qualified permanent triggers on instant/sorcery cast/copy events, not Ignus's creature cast or Abaddon's static cascade.
not_inferred: No claim that arbitrary {C} buys colored spell requirements, generates red automatically or guarantees a game win.
No claim that a life-loss trigger produced AFTER an Ignus cast retroactively adds cascade to that same cast.
No claim that Veyran doubles Impact Tremors ETBs directly; creature ETB is not instant/sorcery cast/copy event.

adversarial_cases.name: Rule of Law already on opposing battlefield
adversarial_cases.baseline: If Loyal Subordinate, Abaddon, Neheb and Aggravated Assault are all already battlefield, a beginning-of-combat lieutenant trigger causes 3 life loss EACH of three opponents, X=9. At first postcombat main Neheb produces 9 {R}; spend {3}{R}{R} on Assault (activated ability, not a spell), schedule an extra combat plus postcombat main. Each extra combat with Loyal still active produces another 9 aggregate life lost; each following Neheb trigger independently counts CUMULATIVE this-turn opponent loss. Rule of Law restricts spells, not these abilities, so finite repetition can defeat opponents without combat damage if engine survives.
adversarial_cases.impact_variant: Birgi/Ignus/Tremors cannot be iterated: after a single Ignus spell is cast in a turn, Rule of Law forbids its next cast; if another spell was already cast this turn, zero Ignus casts are permitted. Abaddon cascade hits also cannot be cast if original was the one spell.
adversarial_cases.verdict: Preserve Neheb+Assault+Loyal as an independent, commander-supported anti-spell-stax combat route; do NOT cut Assault merely to fit Impact.

adversarial_cases.name: Spot removal on Impact trigger stack
adversarial_cases.baseline: After an Ignus recast resolves and its Tremors ETB trigger goes on stack, each opponent receives priority before that trigger resolves. With a nonempty stack the active player may NOT activate Ignus's as-sorcery return ability.
adversarial_cases.impact_variant: Opponent instant-speed removal can destroy Ignus at that window; even if Tremors damage resolves, additional cycles require recasting/recovering Ignus. A counterspell targeting the Ignus creature spell prevents the ETB and also breaks the cycle.
adversarial_cases.verdict: Uncontested deterministic loop is vulnerable; not guaranteed win or empirical win-rate evidence.

adversarial_cases.name: Veyran qualifier versus creature Ignus
adversarial_cases.baseline: Birgi still produces only one red for each Ignus CREATURE cast because Veyran's conditional trigger-doubling clause requires a CAST/COPY INSTANT OR SORCERY to cause the permanent trigger.
adversarial_cases.impact_variant: Veyran amplifies selected 40K inst/sorc exile-cast triggers and Birgi on qualifying spells; it does not recover Familiar's generic reduction nor double Ignus/Impact creature ETB directly.
adversarial_cases.verdict: A Veyran substitution must be justified through enough independent inst/sorc events to outweigh lost earlier command tempo and one net {C} per Ignus cycle.

adversarial_cases.name: Opponent removes Loyal or Neheb mid-combat chain
adversarial_cases.baseline: If Neheb leaves before a subsequent postcombat main, no new red mana from its trigger; if Loyal leaves, repeating combat may continue with X already>=5 but is not lethal without another attack or noncombat source.
adversarial_cases.impact_variant: The Tremors alternative survives some creature-combat restrictions but loses to Rule of Law and instant-speed interruption.
adversarial_cases.verdict: Neither payoff package is disruption-proof; retain cross-axis redundancy.

full_100_research_alternatives.name: IMPACT_ONLY_PRESERVE_FAMILIAR_AND_WARHAMMER
full_100_research_alternatives.merit: Adds reliable commander-independent Birgi/Ignus damage sink, 40K Lost Spawn damage; preserves Nightscape discount+colorless loop, all 40K effects, Neheb+Assault, protection.
full_100_research_alternatives.tradeoff: Removes {U} cantrip smoothing and one-MV cascade hit; not owner-presentable below five, no full finalist verification.

full_100_research_alternatives.name: VEYRAN_IMPACT_PRESERVE_FAMILIAR_LOSE_RUINOUS
full_100_research_alternatives.merit: Retains discounted Abaddon and net-colorless Ignus loop while adding Veyran's broader spell-trigger doubling and Impact finisher; protects Neheb/Assault, counters, Call Forth double cascade, and Lost/Keeper/Nalfeshnee.
full_100_research_alternatives.tradeoff: Loses The Ruinous Powers {2}{B}{R} Warhammer upkeep opponent-deck access, nonhand spell/land feeding and life-loss on stolen spell cast; true identity loss, not free.

full_100_research_alternatives.name: EXISTING_STAGE9_VEYRAN_IMPACT_PRESERVE_RUINOUS_LOSE_FAMILIAR
full_100_research_alternatives.merit: Preserves Ruinous 40K theft/exile access and improves selected spell-cast permanent triggers.
full_100_research_alternatives.tradeoff: Stops Familiar's net +{C} Ignus loop and increases Abaddon UBR cast requirement by one; only worth it for credible high-density Veyran benefits.

conservative_comparative_judgment: NEW RESOURCE FACT INVALIDATES TREATING NIGHTSCAPE AS A LOW-COST Veyran CUT. Neither is owner-ready and no >5 full finalist superiority is claimed; existing stage4–9 5–8 swap research packages remain adversarial comparators rather than quota-filling.
